title: Dy Manager - Strategic Sourcing (Casting)
jobDescription:
What we’re looking for:  

We are looking for a Qualified professional with min 05 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing in 2wh industry for the Aluminum Castings, Forging & Machining Category.  

What you will own and do:

  • Lead end-to-end RFI / RFQ / RFP process for Aluminum Casting components (Gravity Die Casting / High Pressure Die Casting / Low Pressure Die Casting) including parts such as Alloy Wheels, Gear Box Housing, Crank Cases, Motor Housing, etc. 

  • Ensure all commercial terms are finalized and agreed; position and execute NDA, SOW, and Master Purchase Agreements appropriately before initiation of business. 

  • Lead contractual negotiations with suppliers covering NDAs, General Terms & Conditions, and Production Supply Agreements. 

  • Evaluate supplier core competencies, manufacturing capabilities, and competitive positioning using industry cost models and benchmarking tools. 

  • Negotiate with suppliers to achieve best-in-class prototype and production pricing aligned with target costing objectives. 

  • Build and leverage strong cross-functional relationships with Engineering teams and key suppliers to ensure cost optimization, quality compliance, and timely delivery. 

  • Coordinate closely with internal teams to support prototype requirements, execute build milestones, and monitor daily Supply Chain Management & Strategic Sourcing activities. 

  • Track and reconcile Sub-Contracting activities related to Job Work components. 

  • Coordinate with Suppliers and Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) teams to ensure part quality and compliance with specifications. 

  • Ensure Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) assurance for all Aluminium Casting parts. 

What You Will Bring to us:

  •  B.Tech/B.E in Mechanical / Production Engineering or equivalent qualification. 

  • 5–8 years of demonstrated experience in Strategic Sourcing of Automotive 2W components, including 2–4 years of experience with a 2W OEM. 

  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end manufacturing processes from raw material selection to finished goods for Aluminium Casting (Gravity Die Casting / High Pressure Die Casting / Low Pressure Die Casting). 

  • Knowledge of surface treatment processes such as Powder Coating, Painting, and Heat Treatment. 

  • Hands-on experience in Zero Based Costing (ZBC) for Aluminium Casting commodities, including tooling cost analysis. 

  • Understanding of Commodity Price Indexing (Raw Material Indexing). 

  • Working knowledge of PPAP, APQP, and IATF 16949 requirements. 

  • Knowledge of testing and validation requirements at both Part and Assembly levels.

title: Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
jobDescription:
What we are looking for:

We are looking for a high-energy, field-driven sales leader who can build markets from the ground up and accelerate the adoption of electric mobility. The ideal candidate combines strong dealer management and B2B sales experience with a working understanding of EV technology. You enjoy being on the road, building relationships, and turning strategy into action. You are comfortable educating partners and customers, navigating ambiguity, and owning ambitious targets in a fast-scaling startup environment.

What you will own and do:

  • Expand and manage the dealer network across assigned territories, ensuring partners meet EV-specific infrastructure and service standards

  • Drive wholesale (dispatch) and retail (registration) sales performance, consistently achieving monthly and quarterly targets

  • Conduct EV product training and workshops for dealer sales teams, covering battery technology, range optimization, and government incentives

  • Build and close B2B and fleet partnerships with delivery companies, corporate campuses, and ride-sharing startups

  • Track competitor activity, pricing, and new launches, sharing actionable market insights with product and marketing teams

  • Coordinate with partners to enable charging infrastructure at dealerships and key customer locations

  • Ensure strong customer experience by working closely with dealers to maintain high CSAT, post-purchase support, and battery health practices

What you will bring to us:

  • 3–5 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably in Automobile or EV sectors

  • Strong understanding of EV fundamentals including lithium-ion battery lifecycle, charging speeds, and electric drivetrains

  • Hands-on experience using CRM tools, Sales Apps, or Dealer Management Systems (DMS) to track leads and territory performance

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills across diverse audiences

  • High ownership mindset with comfort in extensive travel (up to 70%) within the assigned territory

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering; MBA preferred

We’re not the best fit for you if:

  • You are comfortable with the status quo and not motivated to push yourself or your market further

  • You prefer selling without educating customers or partners on new technology

  • You focus only on short-term numbers and not long-term market creation

  • You avoid calculated risks and fast-moving environments

  • You expect a desk-bound role with rigid structures and minimal field ownership

  • Relocation assistance

  • Health insurance and wellness programs

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities

title: Sr Engineer - Firmware
jobDescription:
What we are looking for:

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer with strong experience in automotive EV ECUs. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in real-time embedded systems, firmware architecture, and safety-critical development. You should be comfortable owning firmware modules end-to-end, driving technical quality, collaborating across hardware and software teams, and mentoring engineers in a fast-paced EV technology environment. 

 What you will own and do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for EV ECUs.

  • Own MCU-level firmware including startup code, linker scripts, interrupts, and device drivers (ADC, PWM, DMA, SPI, I2C, CAN, UART).

  • Ensure deterministic real-time behavior and implement firmware safety mechanisms such as watchdogs, diagnostics, and safe states.

  • Lead board bring-up, hardware–software integration, and debugging using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

  • Integrate firmware with MCAL, AUTOSAR components, and application software.

  • Support CAN/CAN FD communication, UDS diagnostics, and firmware flashing.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews and technical direction. 

What you will bring to us:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Embedded C (C++ is a plus).

  • Deep understanding of ARM Cortex-M MCU architecture (Infineon, TI, STM, NXP) and real-time systems.

  • Experience with CAN/CAN FD, UDS diagnostics, and ECU firmware development.

  • Working knowledge of ISO 26262, ASPICE, MISRA C/C++ standards.

  • Familiarity with AUTOSAR Classic (MCAL/BSW).

  • Experience with debugging and development tools such as Lauterbach, Segger, CANoe/CANalyzer, Polyspace/Coverity, and Git.

  • Ability to independently own firmware modules and mentor engineers.

title: Sr Engineer - MBD
jobDescription:
What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for an experienced Model Based Developer to join our software engineering team working on Electric Vehicle software systems. In this role, you will contribute to the development, testing, and debugging of models and auto-generated code across multiple domains within the EV software architecture. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of how algorithms and control functions are translated into models and further into production-ready code.

We prefer someone who enjoys working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, takes ownership of complex problems, and goes the extra mile to deliver high-quality solutions.

What You Will Own and Do:

  • Develop and debug Simulink and Stateflow models according to functional and technical requirements, following MAAB guidelines.

  • Derive models and software components from mathematical algorithms and physical system behaviors, integrating them into the existing EV software architecture.

  • Generate production code from developed models and evaluate performance using model simulations and HiL systems.

  • Review technical literature and research papers to evaluate and implement state-of-the-art algorithms.

  • Automate development and testing processes using scripts and model-based tools.

  • Independently develop functional logic by referring to the latest technical standards and engineering practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering and Firmware teams to ensure smooth system integration and validation.

What You Will Bring to Us:

  • Strong experience in Model Based Development (MBD) using MathWorks tools such as MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.

  • Experience with auto code generation tools such as Embedded Coder or TargetLink.

  • Hands-on experience developing functions for safety-critical real-time systems.

  • Good understanding of the Automotive Software Development Lifecycle and toolchains.

  • Strong programming knowledge in C and MATLAB scripting (m-scripting) with solid debugging skills.

  • Experience with MBD testing methodologies such as MIL, SIL, and PIL.

  • Familiarity with automotive communication protocols such as CAN and LIN for testing and integration.

  • Experience working with control systems related to Powertrain or Hybrid/Electric systems.

Qualifications:

  • 4–6 years of experience in Model Based Development within the automotive industry.

  • Bachelor’s Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

title: Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
jobDescription:
What we are looking for:

The Manager – Manufacturing Engineering will play a pivotal role in developing, industrializing, and scaling EV two-wheeler manufacturing processes. This role is responsible for end-to-end process design, equipment development, supplier coordination, line readiness, and mass production support for EV vehicle assembly.

The incumbent will work closely with Vehicle Development, Production, Quality, Layout Engineering, and Suppliers to ensure robust, efficient, and scalable manufacturing systems aligned with quality, cost, and delivery targets. 

What you will own and do:

Manufacturing Process & Line Development

  • Design and implement end-to-end EV two-wheeler assembly processes covering chassis, powertrain, and final assembly.

  • Develop manufacturing processes for EV Vehicle Assembly Lines and EV Vehicle Testing & Validation systems.

  • Lead new process development, equipment runoff, installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement for vehicle production lines.

  • Support production teams during new model ramp-up and mass production stabilization.

Equipment, Tools & Technology

  • Prepare RFQs, scopes of work, and conduct technical finalization of SPMs and testing equipment.

  • Hands-on experience with DC and pneumatic tools, press equipment, assembly conveyors, laser marking, EOL dyno systems, and vehicle testing equipment.

  • Ensure equipment placement and installation with focus on ergonomics, safety, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Standards

  • Create and maintain manufacturing gateway documents including PFD, PFA, PFMEA, SOPs, and process digitization.

  • Support SOVP audits and PPAP activities, ensuring compliance with IATF / ISO standards.

  • Prepare and deliver training programs for Manufacturing and Quality teams for new model assembly processes.

Supplier & Vendor Management

  • Prepare budgets and techno-commercial comparisons for equipment and tooling suppliers.

  • Coordinate with vendors for trials, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and handover.

  • Drive new vendor development and manage ongoing supplier performance.

Capacity Planning & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate production capacity against demand and plan for future expansion or de-bottlenecking.

  • Apply Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma tools to improve throughput, quality, and cost efficiency.

  • Ensure station readiness and material availability for vehicle assembly line launches.
